title: Starfield

quotes.text: Easy, girl. Breathe. You'll have a heart attack.
War, disease, famine. All the classics.
By Vectera, by Vectera, by Vectera! I can't believe it!
He's Barrett, I'm Barrett. Other than that mind-bending fact, there's really not much to it.
Starfield shipped with over 200,000 lines of recorded dialogue, more than any prior Bethesda game.
Todd Howard first pitched Starfield's concept back in 2013, years before it entered full production.
Every player scans the first planet's every rock. By the tenth planet, they don't even land.
Players begged for a flight sim, then fast-travel past every system they unlock.

notes: appid 1716740 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, name='Starfield', developer/publisher Bethesda Game Studios/Softworks). Only one Starfield SKU exists on Steam (the storefront page bundles Premium Edition upsells in its description, but the base appid/title are unchanged), so no SKU ambiguity here. Character quotes (Sarah Morgan, The Hunter, Barrett, Adoring Fan) were cross-checked across two independent fan compilations (TheGamer, GearsRealm) that agreed on wording, plus corroborating search results for the Adoring Fan's 'By Vectera' line as a deliberate callback to Oblivion's Adoring Fan ('By Azura'); I could not reach starfieldwiki.net or the Fandom wiki directly (both blocked by Cloudflare bot-checks even via a text-extraction proxy), so these are the best-available verbatim sources. The 200,000-lines-of-dialogue figure and the 2013 pitch date are both widely reported development facts, sourced independently.
